label: The words are arriving on top of each other now
description: What he saw in 2023 and 2024 coming to pass through 2025 so fast that the words are almost on top of each other and he needs to catch up.
aliases: words are almost on top of each other

label: Work while it is day, the night is coming
description: The John 9 passage applied to the present: light seen in 2026 alongside darkness coming, so the harvest must be brought in across 2026 and 2027 while there is still time to work.
aliases: the night is coming when no one can work

label: The New York World Cup fixture list read out as prayer targets
description: He reads the New York World Cup schedule off the official fixture list as targets to pray over: 13, 16, 22, 25, 27 and 30 June, then 5 July, with the final on 19 July in New York City broadcast on CBS, and notes there are 78 games in all and that the New York list is not all of them.
aliases: I saw it on the schedule
July 19th is the World Cup final

label: Wormwood dated to Friday 13 April 2029
description: That what is supposed to be wormwood is 13 April 2029 and will happen on a Friday, offered conditionally as if that is true. The date is the published close approach of the asteroid Apophis, which does fall on a Friday.
aliases: it will happen on a Friday

label: Wormwood: an asteroid strikes in 2029
description: The Revelation wormwood identified as a massive asteroid that he expects to hit the earth, placed around 2029.

label: Wormwood and poisoned water, which he says he did not see
description: Raised in conversation as wormwood water and poison water; he states plainly that he did not see it.

label: A clip of someone prophesying over America at a keyboard
description: A played clip of a man declaring and prophesying over America while playing, the words not made out, presented as carrying a palpable glory, and stated not to be about 2028.
aliases: I couldn't make out what he was saying

label: Buildings seen, and told to write the vision down
description: A sight of buildings and of people filling them, given in the middle of praying in tongues, with instruction to write the vision down. No place, act or date.

label: A writing on the wall experience for the president
description: Prayer that his ears are cleaned out so God speaks to him in the still small voice at night, even if it takes a writing on the wall experience, and shows him how to lead by the Holy Spirit.
aliases: the still small voice in the middle of the night
a writing on the wall experience

label: World war escalation with a US draft
description: American soldiers moved toward Europe under a mass draft as the Russia war escalates.

label: XRP reaches $10,000
description: Ten thousand dollars per unit for an asset he will not name outright, described as starting with an X and having a p in it, at the full manifestation.

label: Yankees against the Dodgers, with attacks attempted on Yankee Stadium
description: Seen in May 2024: the New York Yankees reaching the World Series against the Los Angeles Dodgers, and attempted attacks on Yankee Stadium, with a standing instruction to watch the Yankees.

label: 2027 highlighted big
description: 2027 seen highlighted large with nothing seen about the other years, said to be what they will hear about a lot in the days ahead, with the subject left unstated.
aliases: you're going to hear about it a lot

label: 2028 as a wall he cannot get over
description: 2028 seen huge in black letters with a wall, which he approaches and cannot see past. An absence of sight rather than a claim about the year.
aliases: it says in the vision it's 2028
it's huge and it has a wall

label: The number 2032, highlighted and skipped to
description: The number 2032 seen large and highlighted, arrived at by skipping instantly from 2028 with the intervening years unseen, and with 2028 itself clouded and a black line beyond which he could not see. He states he does not know what it means.

label: Looking back at the year and asking whether he progressed
description: A stated year-end practice of asking where he wants to be next year and whether he made any spiritual progress, alongside thanksgiving for the year closing out.
aliases: did I make any progress spiritually
where I'm at this time next year

label: The coming year is mapped out each December
description: That towards the end of December the Lord sits him down to take notes and maps out the whole coming year, giving an outline of events and prayer targets.
aliases: sit down I want you to take notes

label: 2026 a year like the body of Christ has never experienced
description: That 2026 will be unlike anything they or the church have experienced before, coming to a head, a dandy of a year that they will remember him predicting.
aliases: a year like you've never experienced before
2026 is going to be a dandy

label: 2026 the year of the events, bringing in digital ID
description: That 2026 and 2027 are the years of the events, and that the events bring people in to accept stability and digital identity, with the line that this is just the way it has to be.
aliases: this is just the way it has to go

label: 2027 a year of rain, glory and heaven on earth for the church
description: 2027 brings revival rain, glory over America and the southern states, financial blessing, and heaven on earth for a cleaned-up church, after judgment begins in God's house.

label: 2025 is the year of the baby
description: 2025 declared the year of the baby, with generational curses of miscarriage broken and supernatural full-term births.

label: 2026 is the year of a fix
description: The Lord calls 2026 the year of a fix, which he reads as either a rigged election or an economy fixed to look amazing so people vote red.

label: Something about the young senator will come out
description: That something concerning a young senator is coming out in the days ahead, with the assertion that he is not against the man and a reading that he is already justifying it to himself.
aliases: it will come out in the days ahead
in his mind, he's already justifying it

label: A major revival among the younger generation and college students
description: A major revival with the younger generation, seen specifically among college students and young adults.

label: God told him to be on YouTube
description: The channel's stated origin and early growth.
aliases: god told me to be on youtube

label: Zelensky strong-armed, looking to Macron
description: Zelensky seen under American pressure to settle while looking over his shoulder to Macron for instruction, because the Europeans wanted the status quo kept.
aliases: looking over his shoulder to Macron

label: Zelensky taken out and Ukraine partitioned
description: Zelensky seen being taken out and Ukraine split back to Kiev, with land handed to Putin as an act of peace and a proxy government established. Taken out is left ambiguous.
aliases: I saw Zelensky being taken out
